disposition_reason: Four laboratory-developed chocolate spreads (sea buckthorn or hemp oil recipes, each made from organic or conventional raw materials) were analysed for Pb, Cd (AAS), As (colorimetric) and Hg (flameless AAS); Table 7 prints one value per spread, without a unit.

study.design: product development study comparing organic and conventional raw materials in the same recipes
study.origin: Ukraine (laboratory-made products; raw-material origin not stated)
study.method: AAS (PerkinElmer PinAAcle 900T) for Pb and Cd; colorimetric As; flameless AAS for Hg

material.label_as_printed: Chocolate spread (chocolate paste with almonds, cocoa powder, cocoa butter, cane sugar, milk powder, flax bran)

findings.notes: Table 7 prints no unit; mg/kg is likely but not stated, so value_ugkg is left null; laboratory-developed product, single value, n not stated
